channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Auburn Gresham Neighbors, Faith Leaders Unite After Woman Killed On 79th Street: ‘Don’t Be Silent’
item.description: St. Sabina’s Rev. Michael Pfleger said the church is offering a $10,000 reward for information on the Wednesday afternoon shooting that left a mother dead.

item.title: He Moved His Orphaned Siblings To Chicago Area To Be Their Caretaker. Now, He’s Stuck In ICE Detention
item.description: Federico Alexis Alcantar, 22, is currently being held in a Missouri ICE detention facility. He's been the sole caretaker for his two younger siblings after his father was murdered last year and his mother passed away from cancer in 2022. His community is calling for his immediate release.

item.title: Neighbors Pack Southwest Side Coffee Shop To Show Support For Its Anti-ICE Stance
item.description: Huge lines formed outside A Cup of Joe Coffeehouse as it doubled down on its anti-ICE stance following a boycott by some neighbors. Proceeds from Saturday benefitted an immigrant vendors fund.

item.title: City Worker Found Slain In West Ridge Apartment As $10,000 Reward Offered For Information
item.description: Da'J Flowers, who worked for the city's Office of Emergency Management and Communications, was found dead from multiple gunshot wounds Friday, officials said.

item.title: Gun Violence Down On West Side, But Prevention Groups Say Success Is Threatened By Trump Cuts
item.description: The city's major decrease in murders and shootings in 2025 was led by a small group of community areas primarily on the West and South sides. New efforts helped violence prevention groups achieve that success, but the gains could be undone by Trump budget cuts.

item.title: What’s Your Favorite First-Date Restaurant in Chicago? Here’s What Block Club Readers Say
item.description: From charming Italian deli Gio's to acclaimed farm-to-table Lula Cafe, date-night options abound in the city.

item.title: Humboldt Park Neighbors Turn Frozen Pond Into Pickup Hockey Rink
item.description: Each winter, the Humboldt Hockey Club brings together skaters, families and first-timers for pickup games on the neighborhood pond.

item.title: Temporary Homeless Shelter At Uptown’s American Islamic College To Close This Summer
item.description: The college campus, which is slated for redevelopment, became a temporary migrant shelter in 2023 when thousands of migrants were arriving to the city.

item.title: From Fondue To ‘I Do’: How Geja’s Cafe Became Chicago’s Most Romantic Restaurant
item.description: Owners Jeff and Darla Lawler are expanding the Lincoln Park fondue institution while preserving the candlelit romance that’s defined it for generations.

item.title: Bad Bunny Personally Requested This Chicago Conductor For Super Bowl Halftime Show
item.description: Grant Park Music Festival's artistic director and Grammy-winning conductor Giancarlo Guerrero had about a week to prepare for the performance. "This is something I will never forget," he said.
